title: On waking up
arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
english: All praise is for Allah, who gave us life after He had caused us to die, and to Him is the rising.

title: Before sleeping
arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
english: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

title: Lying down to sleep
note: Said with the right hand under the cheek
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
english: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You raise up Your servants.

title: The last words before sleep
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لَا مَلْجَأَ وَلَا مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ، اللَّهُمَّ آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ
english: O Allah, I submit my face to You, entrust my affairs to You and rely on You completely, in hope of You and in awe of You. There is no refuge and no escape from You except to You. O Allah, I believe in Your Book which You revealed and in Your Prophet whom You sent.

title: Turning over in the night
arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ، رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفَّارُ
english: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, the One, the Prevailing, Lord of the heavens and the earth and all between them, the Mighty, the Forgiving.

title: After a bad dream
note: Blow lightly to your left three times, turn onto your other side, and tell no one about it
arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
english: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.

title: Leaving the home
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
english: In the name of Allah. I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might and no power except with Allah.

title: Leaving the home
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِلَّ أَوْ أُضَلَّ، أَوْ أَزِلَّ أَوْ أُزَلَّ، أَوْ أَظْلِمَ أَوْ أُظْلَمَ، أَوْ أَجْهَلَ أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيَّ
english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from going astray or being led astray, from slipping or being made to slip, from wronging others or being wronged, and from acting foolishly or being treated foolishly.

title: Entering the home
note: Then greet your family with salam
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
english: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we rely.

title: Getting dressed
arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا الثَّوْبَ وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
english: All praise is for Allah, who clothed me with this garment and provided it for me, without any might or power on my part.

title: Wearing something new
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ، أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهِ وَخَيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ
english: O Allah, all praise is Yours. You have clothed me with it. I ask You for its good and the good it was made for, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil it was made for.

title: Taking off your clothes
note: A screen between the jinn and your ‘awrah
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
english: In the name of Allah.

title: Entering the toilet
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
english: In the name of Allah. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the male and female devils.
reference: Al-Bukhari 142; Muslim 375; “In the name of Allah” is reported by Sa‘id ibn Mansur

title: Leaving the toilet
arabic: غُفْرَانَكَ
english: I ask for Your forgiveness.

title: Before wudu
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
english: In the name of Allah.

title: After wudu
arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ، وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
english: I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. O Allah, make me among those who turn to You in repentance, and make me among those who purify themselves.

title: Walking to the mosque
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا، وَفِي لِسَانِي نُورًا، وَفِي سَمْعِي نُورًا، وَفِي بَصَرِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ تَحْتِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ أَمَامِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْ فِي نَفْسِي نُورًا، وَأَعْظِمْ لِي نُورًا، وَعَظِّمْ لِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْ لِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْنِي نُورًا، اللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِنِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْ فِي عَصَبِي نُورًا، وَفِي لَحْمِي نُورًا، وَفِي دَمِي نُورًا، وَفِي شَعْرِي نُورًا، وَفِي بَشَرِي نُورًا
english: O Allah, place light in my heart, light on my tongue, light in my hearing and light in my sight; light above me, light below me, light on my right and light on my left, light before me and light behind me. Place light in my soul, make the light great for me, magnify it for me, give me light and make me light. O Allah, grant me light, and place light in my sinews, my flesh, my blood, my hair and my skin.
reference: Al-Bukhari 6316; Muslim 763; The wording gathered in Hisn al-Muslim

title: Entering the mosque
arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ، وَبِوَجْهِهِ الْكَرِيمِ، وَسُلْطَانِهِ الْقَدِيمِ، مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
english: I seek refuge in Allah the Almighty, in His noble Face and His eternal authority, from Satan the outcast. In the name of Allah, and blessings and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.

title: Leaving the mosque
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اعْصِمْنِي مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
english: In the name of Allah, and blessings and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, I ask You for Your bounty. O Allah, protect me from Satan the outcast.

title: After the adhan
note: After repeating the words of the adhan
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ، وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
english: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and of the prayer about to be established, grant Muhammad al-Wasilah and the excellence, and raise him to the praised station You have promised him.

title: After the salam of the prayer
arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ (ثَلَاثًا)، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ، وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
english: I seek Allah's forgiveness (three times). O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, Possessor of majesty and honour.

title: After the prayer
note: Then SubhanAllah 33, Alhamdulillah 33 and Allahu Akbar 34
arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
english: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is able to do all things. O Allah, none can withhold what You give, none can give what You withhold, and the wealth of the wealthy cannot avail him against You.

title: Before eating
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
english: In the name of Allah.

title: If you forgot to say it at the start
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ
english: In the name of Allah, at its beginning and its end.

title: After eating
arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا، وَرَزَقَنِيهِ، مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
english: All praise is for Allah, who fed me this and provided it for me, without any might or power on my part.

title: A guest's dua for the host
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ، وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ
english: O Allah, bless them in what You have provided them, forgive them and have mercy on them.

title: Breaking the fast
arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ، وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
english: The thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is certain, if Allah wills.

title: Getting into a car or onto a mount
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، ﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ ۝ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ﴾، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
english: In the name of Allah. All praise is for Allah. Glory be to the One who has subjected this to us, for we could never have done it ourselves, and to our Lord we will surely return. All praise is for Allah (three times). Allah is the Greatest (three times). Glory be to You, O Allah. I have wronged myself, so forgive me, for none forgives sins but You.

title: Setting out on a journey
arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، ﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ ۝ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ﴾، اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ
english: Allah is the Greatest (three times). Glory be to the One who has subjected this to us, for we could never have done it ourselves, and to our Lord we will surely return. O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness and piety, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and shorten its distance. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the One who looks after the family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardships of travel, from distressing sights, and from an unhappy return to my wealth and family.

title: Coming home from a journey
note: Said with the travel dua on the way back
arabic: آيِبُونَ، تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
english: We return, repenting, worshipping, and praising our Lord.

title: Stopping at a place
arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
english: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

title: Saying farewell to a traveller
arabic: أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِينَكَ، وَأَمَانَتَكَ، وَخَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ
english: I entrust to Allah your religion, your trust and the last of your deeds.

title: A traveller's farewell to those staying behind
arabic: أَسْتَوْدِعُكُمُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا تَضِيعُ وَدَائِعُهُ
english: I entrust you to Allah, whose trusts are never lost.

title: Entering the market
arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
english: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is Ever-Living and never dies. In His hand is all good, and He is able to do all things.

title: When it rains
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
english: O Allah, let it be a beneficial rain.

title: After the rain
arabic: مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ
english: We have been given rain by the bounty and mercy of Allah.

title: When the wind blows
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا
english: O Allah, I ask You for its good, and I seek refuge in You from its evil.

title: On hearing thunder
arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ
english: Glory be to the One whom the thunder glorifies with His praise, and the angels too, in awe of Him.

title: On seeing the new moon
arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ، وَالتَّوْفِيقِ لِمَا تُحِبُّ رَبَّنَا وَتَرْضَى، رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ
english: Allah is the Greatest. O Allah, bring it over us with security and faith, with safety and Islam, and with success in what You love, our Lord, and what pleases You. Our Lord and your Lord is Allah.

title: For worry and grief
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ، ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ، ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ الْقُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي، وَنُورَ صَدْرِي، وَجَلَاءَ حُزْنِي، وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي
english: O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant. My forelock is in Your hand, Your judgement over me is done, and Your decree for me is just. I ask You by every name that is Yours, with which You named Yourself, or revealed in Your Book, or taught to any of Your creation, or kept with Yourself in the knowledge of the unseen, to make the Quran the spring of my heart, the light of my chest, the departure of my sorrow and the end of my worry.

title: Seeking refuge from anxiety and debt
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and grief, from helplessness and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, and from the burden of debt and being overpowered by others.

title: In distress
arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
english: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, the Almighty, the Forbearing. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, Lord of the mighty Throne. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth and Lord of the noble Throne.

title: The dua of Yunus in hardship
arabic: ﴿لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبۡحَٰنَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ﴾
english: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.

title: When something is hard
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
english: O Allah, nothing is easy except what You make easy, and You make the difficult easy when You will.

title: When struck by a loss
arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي، وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
english: We belong to Allah and to Him we will return. O Allah, reward me in my affliction and give me something better in its place.

title: When angry
arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
english: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.

title: For relief from debt
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
english: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful instead of what You have forbidden, and by Your bounty make me need no one but You.

title: For pain in the body
note: Place your hand where it hurts
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ (ثَلَاثًا)، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ (سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ)
english: In the name of Allah (three times). I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the evil of what I feel and what I fear (seven times).

title: Visiting someone who is ill
arabic: لَا بَأْسَ، طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
english: No harm; it is a purification, if Allah wills.

title: Sneezing, and replying
arabic:
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ
يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ
english: The one who sneezes says: All praise is for Allah. The one who hears says: May Allah have mercy on you. The one who sneezed replies: May Allah guide you and set your affairs right.

title: Thanking someone who did you a favour
arabic: جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا
english: May Allah reward you with good.

title: Congratulating newlyweds
arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
english: May Allah bless you, shower His blessings upon you, and bring you together in goodness.

title: At the end of a gathering
arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
english: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise. I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped but You. I seek Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance.

title: On seeing someone in hardship
note: Said quietly, so the person does not hear
arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلَاكَ بِهِ، وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلًا
english: All praise is for Allah, who has spared me what He has tried you with, and favoured me greatly over much of His creation.

title: When someone says “I love you for Allah’s sake”
arabic: أَحَبَّكَ الَّذِي أَحْبَبْتَنِي لَهُ
english: May the One for whose sake you love me love you.

title: Repaying someone who lent to you
arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ
english: May Allah bless you in your family and your wealth.

title: Consoling someone who lost a loved one
arabic: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ، وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى، وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى، فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ
english: To Allah belongs what He took and what He gave, and everything with Him has an appointed term. So be patient and hope for the reward.

title: Visiting the graves
arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَلَاحِقُونَ، أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ
english: Peace be upon you, people of these dwellings, believers and Muslims. We will surely join you, if Allah wills. I ask Allah for well-being for us and for you.

title: On good news, and on bad
arabic:
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ
english: On something pleasing: All praise is for Allah, by whose favour good things are completed. On something displeasing: All praise is for Allah in every situation.

title: For good in this life and the next
arabic: ﴿رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةٗ وَفِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ حَسَنَةٗ وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ﴾
english: Our Lord, give us in this world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
reference: Al-Baqarah 2:201; The dua the Prophet ﷺ made most often (al-Bukhari 6389)

title: For good deeds to be accepted
arabic: ﴿رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلۡ مِنَّآۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ﴾
english: Our Lord, accept this from us. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing.

title: For a heart that stays guided
arabic: ﴿رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغۡ قُلُوبَنَا بَعۡدَ إِذۡ هَدَيۡتَنَا وَهَبۡ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحۡمَةًۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡوَهَّابُ﴾
english: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from Yourself. Indeed, You are the Bestower.

title: Asking forgiveness, the dua of Adam
arabic: ﴿رَبَّنَا ظَلَمۡنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمۡ تَغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَتَرۡحَمۡنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ﴾
english: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.

title: Before speaking or a hard task
arabic: ﴿رَبِّ ٱشۡرَحۡ لِي صَدۡرِي ۝ وَيَسِّرۡ لِيٓ أَمۡرِي ۝ وَٱحۡلُلۡ عُقۡدَةٗ مِّن لِّسَانِي ۝ يَفۡقَهُواْ قَوۡلِي﴾
english: My Lord, expand my chest for me, ease my task for me, and untie the knot from my tongue, that they may understand my speech.

title: For knowledge
arabic: ﴿رَبِّ زِدۡنِي عِلۡمٗا﴾
english: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

title: For your parents
arabic: ﴿رَبِّ ٱرۡحَمۡهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرٗا﴾
english: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up when I was small.

title: For prayer in your family, and forgiveness
arabic: ﴿رَبِّ ٱجۡعَلۡنِي مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِيۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلۡ دُعَآءِ ۝ رَبَّنَا ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلۡحِسَابُ﴾
english: My Lord, make me one who establishes prayer, and from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication. Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers on the Day the account is established.

title: For your spouse and children
arabic: ﴿رَبَّنَا هَبۡ لَنَا مِنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعۡيُنٖ وَٱجۡعَلۡنَا لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا﴾
english: Our Lord, grant us from among our spouses and offspring comfort to our eyes, and make us an example for the righteous.

title: When in need of provision
arabic: ﴿رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَآ أَنزَلۡتَ إِلَيَّ مِنۡ خَيۡرٖ فَقِيرٞ﴾
english: My Lord, indeed I am in need of whatever good You send down to me.

title: When afraid of people
arabic: ﴿حَسۡبُنَا ٱللَّهُ وَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡوَكِيلُ﴾
english: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.

title: For guidance and contentment
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى، وَالتُّقَى، وَالْعَفَافَ، وَالْغِنَى
english: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity and sufficiency.

title: For a firm heart
arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
english: O Turner of hearts, keep my heart firm upon Your religion.

title: For help in worship
note: Taught to be said at the end of every prayer
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ، وَشُكْرِكَ، وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
english: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You well.

title: For pardon
note: Taught for the nights of Laylat al-Qadr
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
english: O Allah, You are the One who pardons and You love to pardon, so pardon me.

title: Istikhara, seeking Allah's guidance in a decision
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ، وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ (وَيُسَمِّي حَاجَتَهُ) خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي، فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي، ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي، فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ، وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ، ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ
english: O Allah, I seek Your guidance by Your knowledge and Your power by Your power, and I ask You of Your immense bounty. You are able and I am not; You know and I do not, and You are the Knower of the unseen. O Allah, if You know that this matter (name it) is good for me in my religion, my livelihood and my final outcome, then decree it for me, make it easy for me, and bless it for me. And if You know that this matter is bad for me in my religion, my livelihood and my final outcome, then turn it away from me and turn me away from it, decree for me what is good wherever it may be, and make me content with it.

title: After Fajr
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
english: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, wholesome provision, and deeds that are accepted.

title: For good character
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَحْسَنْتَ خَلْقِي فَأَحْسِنْ خُلُقِي
english: O Allah, You have made my form beautiful, so make my character beautiful too.

title: Surah al-Fatihah
arabic: ﴿بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ۝ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ۝ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ۝ مَٰلِكِ يَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ ۝ إِيَّاكَ نَعۡبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسۡتَعِينُ ۝ ٱهۡدِنَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلۡمُسۡتَقِيمَ ۝ صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غَيۡرِ ٱلۡمَغۡضُوبِ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ﴾
english: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful, Sovereign of the Day of Recompense. It is You we worship and You we ask for help. Guide us to the straight path, the path of those upon whom You have bestowed favour, not of those who have earned anger or of those who are astray.
reference: Al-Fatihah 1:1–7; Recited as a ruqya by a Companion and approved by the Prophet ﷺ (al-Bukhari 5736, Muslim 2201)

title: Ayat al-Kursi
arabic: ﴿ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلۡحَيُّ ٱلۡقَيُّومُۚ لَا تَأۡخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٞ وَلَا نَوۡمٞۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِي يَشۡفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِهِۦۚ يَعۡلَمُ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيۡءٖ مِّنۡ عِلۡمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَۚ وَسِعَ كُرۡسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفۡظُهُمَاۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيُّ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ﴾
english: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what will be after them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
reference: Al-Baqarah 2:255; Protection from Satan until morning (al-Bukhari 2311)

title: The last two ayahs of al-Baqarah
arabic: ﴿ءَامَنَ ٱلرَّسُولُ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡهِ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَۚ كُلٌّ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيۡنَ أَحَدٖ مِّن رُّسُلِهِۦۚ وَقَالُواْ سَمِعۡنَا وَأَطَعۡنَاۖ غُفۡرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ ۝ لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفۡسًا إِلَّا وُسۡعَهَاۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتۡ وَعَلَيۡهَا مَا ٱكۡتَسَبَتۡۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذۡنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوۡ أَخۡطَأۡنَاۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحۡمِلۡ عَلَيۡنَآ إِصۡرٗا كَمَا حَمَلۡتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِنَاۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلۡنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦۖ وَٱعۡفُ عَنَّا وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَٱرۡحَمۡنَآۚ أَنتَ مَوۡلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرۡنَا عَلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ﴾
english: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and so have the believers. All of them have believed in Allah, His angels, His books and His messengers, saying: We make no distinction between any of His messengers. And they say: We hear and we obey. We seek Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the final destination. Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity. It will have what good it has earned and bear what evil it has earned. Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we forget or err. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. Pardon us, forgive us and have mercy upon us. You are our Protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.
reference: Al-Baqarah 2:285–286; Whoever recites them at night, they will suffice him (al-Bukhari 5009, Muslim 807)

title: Surah al-Ikhlas
arabic: ﴿قُلۡ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ ۝ لَمۡ يَلِدۡ وَلَمۡ يُولَدۡ ۝ وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدُۢ﴾
english: Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, nor is there to Him any equivalent.

title: Surah al-Falaq
arabic: ﴿قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلۡفَلَقِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّـٰثَٰتِ فِي ٱلۡعُقَدِ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ﴾
english: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, from the evil of what He created, from the evil of darkness when it settles, from the evil of those who blow on knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.
reference: Al-Falaq 113; The Prophet ﷺ recited it over himself when ill (al-Bukhari 5016, Muslim 2192)

title: Surah an-Nas
arabic: ﴿قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ ۝ مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ ۝ إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ ٱلۡوَسۡوَاسِ ٱلۡخَنَّاسِ ۝ ٱلَّذِي يُوَسۡوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ ۝ مِنَ ٱلۡجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ﴾
english: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the Sovereign of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer, who whispers in the breasts of mankind, from among the jinn and mankind.
reference: An-Nas 114; The Prophet ﷺ recited it over himself when ill (al-Bukhari 5016, Muslim 2192)

title: Over someone who is ill
note: Wipe over the place of pain with the right hand
arabic: أَذْهِبِ الْبَاسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، اشْفِ وَأَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
english: Take away the harm, Lord of mankind, and heal, for You are the Healer. There is no healing but Your healing, a healing that leaves no illness behind.

title: The ruqya of Jibril
arabic: بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ، مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ يُؤْذِيكَ، مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ أَوْ عَيْنِ حَاسِدٍ، اللَّهُ يَشْفِيكَ، بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ
english: In the name of Allah I perform ruqya over you, from everything that harms you, from the evil of every soul or envious eye. May Allah heal you. In the name of Allah I perform ruqya over you.

title: Asking Allah to heal someone
arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ، رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
english: I ask Allah the Almighty, Lord of the mighty Throne, to heal you.

title: Protecting children
note: The Prophet ﷺ said this over al-Hasan and al-Husayn; say أُعِيذُكَ for one child
arabic: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ، مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
english: I seek protection for you both in the perfect words of Allah, from every devil and every poisonous creature, and from every evil eye.
